findings.name: audit-shadowed
findings.message: never has effect on api.example.com: Enforce policy "enforce-everyone" claims the host for every actor this Audit policy selects, and an Enforce policy always takes precedence, so these routes are never consulted and no audit is ever recorded; its logAllowed still applies

findings.name: tls-passthrough
findings.message: testdata/lint/egress-policy.yaml forwards TLS to audit-only.example.com on port 443 without decrypting it (rules[1].tlsPassthrough "*.example.com"), so ate-gress never sees those requests and this policy is not enforced on them for the actor in atespace research that the EgressPolicy belongs to

findings.name: audit-partly-shadowed
findings.message: has no effect on files.example.com for the actors that Enforce policy "enforce-teams" also selects, such as team-prod/a: an Enforce policy always takes precedence there, so these routes are not consulted and no audit is recorded for them

findings.name: redundant-path
findings.message: "/v2/library/alpine" is redundant: "/v2/**" in the same route already allows everything it matches for GET, HEAD

findings.name: redundant-path
findings.message: "/v2/library/alpine/manifests/latest" is redundant: "/v2/**" (spec.hosts[0].routes[0].paths[0]) already allows everything it matches for GET

findings.name: redundant-path
findings.message: "/token" is redundant: "/token" (spec.hosts[0].routes[0].paths[2]) already allows everything it matches for GET

findings.name: overlapping-routes
findings.message: "/token" is already allowed for GET by "/token" (spec.hosts[0].routes[0].paths[2]); only its other methods add anything

findings.name: tls-passthrough
findings.message: testdata/lint/egress-policy.yaml forwards TLS to registry.example.com on port 443 without decrypting it (rules[1].tlsPassthrough "*.example.com"), so ate-gress never sees those requests and this policy is not enforced on them for the actor in atespace research that the EgressPolicy belongs to; it is enforced only on port 8443 (rules[2].https "registry.example.com")

findings.name: host-not-reached
findings.message: no http or https rule in testdata/lint/egress-policy.yaml reaches unreached.example.net, so the gateway refuses that traffic before it calls ate-gress and this claim has no effect for the actor in atespace research that the EgressPolicy belongs to
